name: inline-formats
body:
yaml : Yaml
yaml = "name: app"
xml : Xml
xml = "<a/>"
csv : CSV
csv = "a,b\n"
markdown : Markdown.Document
markdown = "# Hello\n"
asciidoc : AsciiDoc
asciidoc = "= Hello\n\nworld\n"
request : HTTP.RequestLiteral
request = "GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: example.com\r\n\r\n"
response : HTTP.ResponseLiteral
response = "HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\nContent-Length: 0\r\n\r\n"
roc : RocSyntax
roc = "answer = 42\n"
value = yaml.get("name") == Ok(Text("app")) and xml.root.name() == Ok("a") and csv.records.len() == 1 and markdown.blocks.len() == 1 and asciidoc.title == "Hello" and request.value.target == "/" and response.value.status_code == 200 and roc.consumed

name: typed-and-multiline
body:
config : Yaml.Decoded({ port : U16, name : Str })
config =
    \\port: 8080
    \\name: app
people : CSV.Decoded({ name : Str, age : U8 })
people =
    \\name,age
    \\Ada,36
large : Yaml.Decoded(U64)
large = "18446744073709551615"
expected : U64
expected = 18446744073709551615
other : Yaml.Decoded({ rate : Str })
other = "rate: 1.10"
value = config.value.port == 8080 and people.value == [{ name: "Ada", age: 36 }] and large.value == expected and other.value.rate == "1.10"

name: imported-formats
body:
import "settings.yaml" as yaml_text : Str
import "document.xml" as xml_text : Str
import "people.csv" as csv_text : Str
import "document.md" as md_text : Str
import "document.adoc" as adoc_text : Str
import "request.http" as http_text : Str
import "assets/source.roc" as roc_text : Str
config : { port : U16 }
config = Literal.require(Yaml.validate_as({ source: yaml_text, name: "settings.yaml" }))
xml = Literal.require(Xml.validate({ source: xml_text, name: "document.xml" }))
people : List({ name : Str, age : U8 })
people = Literal.require(CSV.validate_as({ source: csv_text, name: "people.csv" }))
markdown = Literal.require(Markdown.validate({ source: md_text, name: "document.md" }))
asciidoc = Literal.require(AsciiDoc.validate({ source: adoc_text, name: "document.adoc" }))
request = Literal.require(HTTP.validate_request({ source: http_text, name: "request.http" }))
roc = Literal.require(RocSyntax.validate({ source: roc_text, name: "assets/source.roc" }))
value = config.port == 8080 and xml.root.name() == Ok("a") and people == [{ name: "Ada", age: 36 }] and markdown.len() == 1 and asciidoc.title == "Hello" and request.target == "/" and roc.consumed

name: configured-checks
body:
yaml = Literal.require(Yaml.validate({ source: "answer: yes", lints: { legacy_booleans: False } }))
csv = Literal.require(CSV.validate({ source: "a,a
x,y
", header: Exact, lints: { duplicate_headers: False } }))
empty_header = Literal.require(CSV.validate({ source: ",b
x,y
", header: Exact, lints: { empty_headers: False } }))
xml = Literal.require(Xml.validate({ source: "<?xml version='1.0' encoding='ISO-8859-1'?><a/>", lints: { non_utf8_declaration: False } }))
markdown = Literal.require(Markdown.validate({ source: "```
x
", lints: { unclosed_fences: False } }))
asciidoc = Literal.require(AsciiDoc.validate({ source: "include::missing.adoc[]
", lints: { unexpanded_includes: False } }))
request = Literal.require(HTTP.validate_request({ source: "POST / HTTP/1.1
Host: a
Content-Length: 0
Content-Length: 0

", lints: { repeated_content_length: False } }))
roc = Literal.require(RocSyntax.validate({ source: "answer = ...
", lints: { placeholders: False } }))
value = yaml.get("answer") == Ok(Text("yes")) and csv.len() == 2 and empty_header.len() == 2 and xml.root.name() == Ok("a") and markdown.len() == 1 and !asciidoc.blocks.is_empty() and request.body.is_empty() and roc.consumed

name: decoder-options
body:
config : { user_id : U8 }
config = Literal.require(Yaml.validate_as({ source: "user-id: 7\n", keys: KebabCase, unknown_keys: Reject }))
people : List({ full_name : Str })
people = Literal.require(CSV.validate_as({ source: " Full Name \nAda\n", header: Normalized }))
pairs : List((Str, U8))
pairs = Literal.require(CSV.validate_as({ source: "Ada,36\n", header: Absent }))
value = config.user_id == 7 and people == [{ full_name: "Ada" }] and pairs == [("Ada", 36)]

name: custom-combinator
body:
Count := { value : U64 }.{
    from_quote : Str -> Try(Count, [BadQuotedBytes(Str)])
    from_quote = |source| Utf8.parse_quote({ parser: Utf8.digits, source }).map_ok(|value| Count.{ value })
}
count : Count
count = "42"
value = count.value == 42
